# Unilever
> Unilever is one of the world's leading suppliers of Beauty & Wellbeing, Personal Care, Home Care and Foods products, with sales in over 190 countries and products used by 3.7 billion people every day. It has 96,000 employees globally and generated sales of €50.5 billion in 2025.

## Company information
- [About Unilever](https://www.unilever.com/our-company/) - High level information about Unilever and its brands.
- [Unilever a glance](https://www.unilever.com/our-company/at-a-glance/) - Unilever's structure, key facts and figures.
- [Unilever's leadership](https://www.unilever.com/our-company/our-leadership/) - Information on Unilever's leadership, including their responsibilities and previous roles.
- [Annual Report & Accounts](https://www.unilever.com/investors/annual-report-and-accounts/) - Information about financial performance, Unilever's Board, verified facts, progress against our sustainability goals and much more.

## Investors
- [Investors](https://www.unilever.com/investors/) - Financial reporting and events, shareholder information and corporate governance.

## Business Groups
- [Beauty & Wellbeing](https://www.unilever.com/brands/beauty-wellbeing/) - Hair Care, Skin Care, and Vitamins, Minerals and Supplements with brands such as Dove, Vaseline, Dermalogica, Paula's Choice, Nutrafol and Liquid I.V..
- [Personal Care](https://www.unilever.com/brands/personal-care/) - Deodorants, Oral Care and Skin Cleansing with brands such as Dove, Dove Men+Care, Rexona, LUX, Axe, Lifebuoy, Closeup and Pepsodent.
- [Home Care](https://www.unilever.com/brands/home-care/) - Fabric Cleaning, Fabric Enhancers and Home & Hygiene with brands such as Dirt Is Good (OMO and Persil), Sunlight, Comfort, Cif and Domestos.
- [Foods](https://www.unilever.com/brands/foods/) - Condiments, Cooking Aids & Mini-Meals and Unilever Food Solutions with brands such as Knorr and Hellmann's.

## News
- [News](https://www.unilever.com/news) - Feature stories covering business performance, brands and marketing, science and technology and sustainability.

## Media
- [Press and media](https://www.unilever.com/news/press-and-media/) - Company press releases and media resources.

## Sustainability
- [Sustainability](https://www.unilever.com/sustainability/) - Sustainability priorities and initiatives.

## Social
- [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/unilever)
- [X](https://x.com/unilever)
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/unilever/posts/?feedView=all)
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/unilever)
